authorizedScope: This record accepts the measured memory peaks and records the sampling, forensic, and interpretation corrections. It does not authorize another Run, an R3 plan, candidate selection, calibration, or production use.

componentReviews.statement: The R2 attempt stopped after 15 sealed schema-failure runs. The sixteenth launch was not sealed. Metrics and gates were not produced.
Post-exit cgroup disappearance keeps the last complete sample. Scope loss while the child is active is an infrastructure failure. A context-memory pass still requires a complete cgroup peak.
All 15 sealed runs have null output digests. Schema-error paths were not retained. Failure authority stays unresolved, so the candidate is not called schema-noncompliant.
Behavioral measurement was attempted and did not complete. The conclusion is partial-inconclusive. Candidate metrics were not produced.
The measured peaks stay within the resident ceiling with 613232640 bytes of headroom. This is not production-capacity evidence. One candidate process at a time stays mandatory.
The R2 plan digest is consumed and is not reusable. No replacement or R3 digest is issued.
The infrastructure defect requires review. The recommendation does not authorize another Run or an R3 plan.
Track 9 stays not ready because the corpus did not complete and the summary stop is telemetry-unresolved.

decision: memory measurements accepted and bounded corrections recorded for review before commit
